label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Cookbook async multi-agent orchestration shows tool firing order. Two patterns: 1) Fixed N-agent team with peer messaging through shared hub, 2) Dynamically spawned async subagents. Shared building blocks: event dict with asyncio.Event per agent, status dict, ID counter, register/new_name/post methods. Uses Anthropic Python SDK + asyncio. No domain task - just mechanics so users can drop in their own tools/task. Shows exactly which tools fire and in what order. Runs typically under 30 seconds with any API key. Enables understanding of tool firing order before adding domain logic.
